blockade by sugarcane farmers over their demand of higher cane price continues on Wednesday morning as well.<span class="id-r-component br" data-pos="2"></span>Around 20 hours into the blockade led by ex-MP Raju Shetti started, no govt minister or it's representative have approached the protesters to end the blockade.<span class="id-r-component br" data-pos="4"></span>Hundreds of cane farmers slept on road overnight including Shetti who night earlier has warned to stop the milk and vegetables supply to Mumbai and Pune if the price demand is not met.<span class="id-r-component br" data-pos="6"></span>According to the highway police, the traffic diversions have been placed at various locations along the stretch from Karad to Kagal and they have appealed commuters to follow diversions strictly to avoid further inconvenience. <!-- -->The trucks continues to remain stranded across both sides of the protest venue.<span class="id-r-component br" data-pos="12"></span>The diversions are at Karad, Peth Naka towards Pune side, at Sangli Phata, Toap, Wathar, Kagal, Uchgaon Phata towards Kolhapur side of the highway.<span class="id-r-component br" data-pos="14"></span>According to ths sources, Kolhapur district collector Vijay Rathod is likely to step in.
